decisions.reason: Translating the Topic field label as 'tema' does not resolve or change the separate requirement that Danish be the document default language.
The source specifies one field label's Danish text but does not change the candidate's generic rules for label coverage, help-text placement, persistence, or matching behavior.
Changing the displayed Topic label to 'tema' does not alter how placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The field-label translation has no effect on bullet size, appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source changes user-facing wording only and does not change the field implementation mechanism or architecture.
The translation of one field label does not change the required style catalog, its source system, or its template-set coverage.
The source clarifies that the displayed Topic label is 'tema' but does not change the requirement that Item and Title align with the other Board Meeting fields.
Renaming the displayed Topic label does not change the required behavior when inserting a row or line immediately after that field.
The field-label translation does not alter hard-return spacing for continuous paragraph text.
The source contains no decision about theme colors or which color options are available.
The Topic label translation does not affect fixed margins or visibility of the adjacent pencil icon in the Guidance template.
The source translates a user-facing field label, not a Word style name, and therefore does not change the style prefix or style-name language policy.
